name: pixel-quota-tree
description: Grow a pixel-art tree from your AI coding agent token usage (Claude Code, Codex, ...).

quotaTree.window.description: Time window whose usage is shown as leaves.

quotaTree.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often agent logs are rescanned (only new bytes are parsed).

quotaTree.countCacheReads.description: Include cache-read tokens in totals. They are cheap and usually dwarf everything else, so they are excluded by default.

quotaTree.tokensPerLeaf.description: Tokens represented by one leaf. 0 = automatic, based on the selected window.

quotaTree.claude.tokenBudget5h.description: Optional Claude Code token budget for a rolling 5h window (0 = off). Claude Code logs do not contain plan limits, so set your own to get a quota bar.

quotaTree.claude.tokenBudgetWeekly.description: Optional Claude Code token budget for a rolling 7-day window (0 = off).

quotaTree.claude.dataDirs.description: Override Claude Code data directories (folders containing 'projects'). Default: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, ~/.claude, ~/.config/claude.

quotaTree.codex.dataDirs.description: Override Codex home directories. Default: $CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.
